_comment: Tunable config for scripts/heal_wedged_review_sessions.py. Pulse-Check adjusts these values (no hand-picked constants in the healer). marker_grace_seconds: idle window after a terminal marker before a provably-done session is auto-reaped (Case 1). silent_grace_seconds: idle window with NO marker before a session is flagged as a silent-wedge candidate (Case 2, alert/confidence-ladder path). hard_silent_grace_seconds: idle window with NO marker beyond which a session is auto-reaped DETERMINISTICALLY, independent of the confidence ladder — set well above the longest legitimate silent operation (the foreground regression gate, ~10 min) so it only ever fires on a provably-wedged session; this is what lets the healer act on the FIRST wedge (PR #101 / #334) instead of waiting for the streak to graduate. streak_to_promote: consecutive Case-2 true positives required to graduate the 15-min alert path from alert-only to auto-reap. build_handoff_grace_seconds: ADDED on top of marker_grace_seconds for Forge sessions only — a per-task grace keyed to the build-sequence advancer's cadence (ourliberty-build-sequence-advancer.timer, OnCalendar=*:0/5 = 300s) so a marker-present Forge session in the preflight->build handoff window isn't reaped before the advancer has had a full cycle to dispatch the next phase. This (with the queued-build-dispatch and open-PR spare checks) closes the false-positive reaping that stranded ccd-s1 (2026-06-10 1:11PM false-alert chain). wedge_progress_grace_seconds: forward-PROGRESS grace for Forge sessions (2026-06-24 forge-post-open-mergeable-rebase-001 deadlock). A session that has made NO new commit in its worktree AND NO new session-log activity for this long is provably wedged and holding the single Forge slot; the spare guard then RELEASES (bypassing the queued-build + open-unreviewed-PR spares, which only protect in-flight work) so the slot is freed. Set well above the ~10-min regression gate and far under the 4h timeout=14400s backstop. The reap kills the PID but preserves the worktree so the watcher's in-process --resume retry finishes the task cleanly.
